visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a white floral dress with small purple and yellow flowers, sits in a well-lit indoor room. She holds several white and silver nail gel pen boxes and individual pens toward the camera. Her facial expression is bright and smiling as she looks directly at the lens. Behind her, a simple wall with a framed abstract blue print and a small cat figurine on a shelf are visible. (2) The scene transitions to a series of close-up shots. First, her hands holding three grey-colored gel pens against a neutral background. Then, she demonstrates twisting the bottom of a pen to reveal a brush tip. She meticulously applies a greyish-purple gel to her natural fingernails on her left hand. A small, portable silver UV curing light is shown being held over her hand, emitting a bright blue light. (3) The camera shows the finished result of the single-color application on her hand, which has a glossy, semi-transparent purple-grey finish. She then demonstrates applying a different 'cat eye' gel pen with silver glitter. She uses a small rectangular magnet near her nail to move the glitter particles, creating a shimmering effect. The UV light is used again to cure the gel. (4) The woman holds up both hands, showing the two different effects: one hand with the solid purple-grey color and the other with the shimmering magnetic cat-eye effect. She smiles and poses with her hands near her face. She then gives a thumbs-up gesture to the camera, appearing satisfied with the results.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and a bright, youthful tone, greeting the audience. The background music is an upbeat, electronic pop track with a steady rhythmic drum beat and melodic synth pads. The speech is clear and fast-paced. (2) As the product demonstration begins, the vocal narration continues, explaining the features of the gel pens. The music maintains its tempo. Several short 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are added to emphasize visual transitions and text overlays. The sound of a plastic pen cap being removed is subtly audible. (3) The voice changes to a slightly more focused tone during the instructional part of the demonstration. The BGM persists as a continuous layer. Transition SFX trigger with every major visual change or new step being highlighted by text. (4) The video concludes with the female voice expressing enthusiasm and a positive recommendation. The music swells slightly before fading out at the very end. The overall audio mix is clean with the vocal track positioned prominently over the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Step-by-Step Demonstration -> Result Comparison -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a product review and tutorial for 'and us' brand nail gel pens purchased from 3coins in Japan. The creator aims to show the ease of use, low cost, and professional results of the product to her audience, encouraging them to consider it as a DIY beauty option.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed product demonstration, price mentioning, brand name display, and explicit recommendation.
